info.title: cibo.hk — HK IPO Allotment Forecasts & Allottee-Profile Analysis
info.description: Public HK IPO data API: allotment forecasts, allottee profiles, prospectus details, allotment results, inclusion analysis, rankings, disclosures, full-market directory, and cross-market data. No API key required. See https://cibo.hk/llms.txt for the agent discovery doc and https://cibo.hk/mcp for the MCP server.

get.description: Return allotment tier data for a stock (public, used by page JS).

Full prospectus info page data: prospectus details (incl. greenshoe,
subscription tiers, secondary listing), cornerstone investors, IPO financial
statements, IPO timeline, directors, syndicate, stabilizing manager.

Full allotment results page data: allotment summary (offer price,
oversubscription, international placing, greenshoe), international placing
concentration, cornerstone allocation + lock-up, and Pool A/B tiers.

中签画像 (allottee profile): winner demographics parsed from the registrar
allotment dataset — total lots, person/company split, region/nationality,
province, gender, age histogram + pyramid, and HK ID letter/era/district.

个股公告中心 (announcement center): all HKEXnews announcements for one
stock, grouped by headline category with publish date and file URL.

回购明细 (per-stock buyback): share buyback records for one stock, newest
first, with per-day shares/amount and aggregate totals.

增减持明细 (per-stock disclosure-of-interest): DI records for one stock,
newest first, with holder, capacity, event type, shares and pct.

Return pre-computed prediction grid for a given agent and stock.

Used by the allotment prediction page JS when switching agents.
The grid covers 18 oversub levels x 5 alpha levels for interpolation.

Query params:
    agent: agent key, e.g. knn_calibrated, historical, knn_raw, ridge, etc.

Compute a single-point allotment prediction for arbitrary oversub/alpha.

Unlike /api/stocks/{code}/predict (default params) and
/api/predict-agent-grid/{code} (fixed 18x5 grid), this accepts any positive
oversub multiple and any alpha in [0,1], computing the result on demand so
AI agents can query e.g. "假设最终超购 300 倍" directly.

When oversub is omitted, defaults to cibo's predicted final oversubscription
multiple (model median blended with the margin-broker forecast).

post.description:
Compute exact single-point predictions for a batch of (oversub, alpha) pairs.

Backs the prediction page's debounced exact rendering so the on-page numbers
match /predict/custom and the MCP predict_allotment tool (no client-side grid
interpolation). Body: {"points": [{"oversub": 300, "alpha": 0.5}, ...],
"agent": "knn_calibrated"} — capped at 64 points per request.
